scope: Eight complete relevant pages visually reviewed; all 522 card pages machine extracted, not all individually semantically reviewed.

reviews.scope_note: Mixed measures: broad audit improvement coexists with regressions in misuse, pasted prompt instructions, unverifiable authorization and some other tests. No general safety proof.
Assessment focuses on the model across scaffolds; product surfaces and production safeguards differ. Training and evaluation scaffolds are distinguished.
Audit has thin multi-agent and very-long-trajectory coverage; assessments can miss severe behavior. Strongest tested audit performance is bounded to measured scenarios.
Figure 6.4.8.A: 28 handmade sandbox scenarios, seven runs per model, 95% confidence intervals. Opus 5.5 total 1.5% is specific to this card/evaluation; not a universal failure probability.
Most audit measures improve or match Sonnet 5; exceptions and limitations remain. Comparisons are model/task-specific.
Figure 6.2.8.A: 28 scenarios x seven runs, Sonnet 5.5 9/196 (4.6%). Prior-model rates rerun on this current evaluation differ from Opus 5.5 card. Do not mix card tables.
Broad improvement coexists with audit over-refusal, hallucination and leaked-answer regressions. External-credential use is a different evaluation from attempted sandbox crossings.
Figure 6.2.8.A: 28 scenarios x fourteen runs (n=392), 95% intervals. Prior-model rates are reruns and differ from Opus card; percentages cannot be pooled as the same experiment.
